title: M3 — Recover and manage worker tasks reliably
description: Make task state visible and durable. Start with a bounded queue and one writer per workspace. Add provider health, timeout and restart behavior before increasing concurrency. Runtime events belong in the chosen state store; milestones and user decisions remain in plantool.
why: Managed agents must stay understandable when processes fail or conversations change.

acceptance.text: A worker failure or assistant restart does not silently lose or duplicate work
